heroes.name: Lin
heroes.bio: Lin follows the old patrol routes in search of survivors. The orange scarf once belonged to the previous firekeeper.
heroes.quote: As long as the fire still burns, we can find our way home.
heroes.traitDesc: The torch recharges 20% faster within the firelight.

heroes.name: Gale
heroes.bio: Gale repaired the fire patrol's tools at the mill. Since the storm, he has been waiting for someone to bring the Overseer out.
heroes.quote: Even cold iron can glow red again.
heroes.traitDesc: Maximum health +2 and attack damage +1. Movement is 6% slower, and torchlight drains 5% faster at night.

heroes.name: Suheng
heroes.bio: Suheng gathers medicinal plants in the Frost Bog and leaves remedies along the trails for anyone who gets separated.
heroes.quote: Frost may hide the veins of a leaf, but the roots are still alive.

heroes.name: Corvus
heroes.bio: Corvus looks for game trails before sunset and listens to the woods to tell which paths are still open.
heroes.quote: The tracks stop here. Take the other path.
heroes.traitDesc: Maximum health −1. Movement is 12% faster, and invulnerability after a hit lasts 0.15 seconds longer.

heroes.name: Alvin
heroes.bio: Alvin copies the notes left behind in the camps into a single book, including the names of the people who traveled with him.
heroes.quote: Save my last page for dawn.
heroes.traitDesc: Maximum health −1. Movement is 2% faster, the light radius is 15% wider, and torchlight drains 15% more slowly at night.
